How it was measured

Every launcher ran with its own defaults and was scored by one script on what its window shows. Each ran in its own Docker image on its own Boat cloud box, taking turns with Torchlight on the same two CPUs over three rounds, and again on a Linux desktop. Search quality came out identical in every round and on every machine, except that GNOME and Ulauncher order tied results by how files sit on disk, which moved a few of their app answers between machines.

The method, its caveats and the raw results are in docs/comparison.md.
